review_candidates.title: 3rd Line Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Windows Server/Hyper-V: Strong experience installing Windows Server and designing, deploying and troubleshooting Hyper-V environments, together with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP. Backup/DR: Good practical experience configuring, troubleshooting and recovering server/VM backups and disaster recovery solutions. The key requirement is that candidates have genuine hands-on implementation and troubleshooting experience, rather than simply having supported systems installed by others.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Our client - a long-established Bedford based IT Company - is looking to recruit an experienced, hands-on 3rd Line Infrastructure Engineer to replace a long-standing engineer who will shortly be retiring. Firewalls/Routers: Hands-on WatchGuard and/or DrayTek experience, including VPNs, VLANs, routing, failover and ideally WatchGuard high-availability/FireCluster configurations. The key requirement is that candidates have genuine hands-on implementation and troubleshooting experience, rather than simply having supported systems installed by others.
